what: Three photos stacked in one spot take turns, dividing one 21s loop into three (7s apart) — each one fades in straight over 0→13% of the loop, stays until 34%, goes out at 37%, and approaches linearly from 1 to 1.2 scale throughout the loop. The next one starts turning on before the previous goes off, so they melt together. For the first 2.7 seconds the first photo brightens from transparent (as in the original) — for the hero photo and brush-strip pattern inside the torn-edge mask

options.--fx-dur: One loop (css), default 21s — each section is on for about 1/3 of that
options.look: four: With four sections, delay each by 1/4 (default is three)
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Photo slots to overlap (direct children of the panel, three — four with look: four)

note: Give the panel a size (aspect-ratio or height) — all stages overlap as absolute

from.where: index.html .sg-fv__photo · .sg-fv__brush (original #fv .bg_area .images img — @keyframes main 0% transparent · 1x, 13% 1, 34% 1, 37% 0, 100% 0 · 1.2x, 21s linear infinite, each slide delayed by 21s/3)
